title: Solubilities and Structures in Aqueous Aliphatic Hydrocarbon Solutions
authors: W. F. Claussen and M. F. Polglase
experimental_method: Microcombustion method: water saturated with the hydrocarbon by bubbling, dissolved gas stripped with oxygen, burned over CuO at 700 C and the CO2 weighed.
uncertainties_stated: Reproducibility within at least 1% from detailed run data; data not corrected for slight gas impurities or saturating bubble size.
quality_remarks: Methane 99.7% (N2 main impurity), ethane 99.9%, propane and n-butane 99%. Authors' averages differ from Winkler's methane values by about 2-10%. The PDF begins with the last paragraph of another article (NMR, p. 4817); Table I is on journal page 4818 of THIS paper. Propane/n-butane literature values are single points at 17 C.
not_extracted_tables: Table II (heats and entropies of solution at 25 C): derived by authors from the solubility fits
Table III (iceberg structure assignments): not data

row_counts.table_1: printed 16 data rows + 4 gas label rows; written 16 data rows + 4 label rows (20 rows)

extraction_notes: Text layer of the table was scrambled (columns, dropped digits), so the table was re-read entirely from the 220 dpi image; no text-layer-derived CSV existed. Printed values like .0547 written as 0.0547 for the first row of each block as printed with leading zero; subsequent rows printed without leading zero are written with 0. Individual-value cells joined with '; '. Sanity: alpha decreases with T within each gas; average lies within the individual values.
needs_pass2_reason: text layer scrambled; whole table read from image, so a blind second read is warranted
